Rutgers University
Institute of Jazz Studies

It's April 17, 1980 and we're resuming our interview with Cozy Cole, the great jazz drummer and we took an overnight break. In the process Cozy got to listen to some tapes of some things he hasn't heard in a while, and he got to also look at John Charlton's Who's Who in Jazz. And that brought some memories--what did that all bring to mind, Cozy?
